prompt_owner: TTM project authored for this design

design.intervention: Change one short phrase inside same authored prompt; keep prefix/suffix and terminal bytes identical inside each pair.
design.condition_A_B: Labels are arbitrary contrast variants; A/B not treated as random treatment assignment.
design.serialization: Use exact prompt_text, UTF-8, no trailing ASCII space, no chat template, no system wrapper, no leading generation whitespace injection; raw P02 tokenizer and model
design.future_estimated_cost_not_actual: max 32 * 64 tokens, CPU-only one batch; cap execution separately before permit

future_candidate_gate.min_category_coverage: at least one pair passes in each of four categories
